sloka: तस्मात् मे शबलाम् देहि मम एषा धर्मतो द्विज ।एवम् उक्तः तु भगवान् वसिष्ठो मुनि सत्तमः ॥१-५३-१०॥
transliteration: tasmāt me śabalām dehi mama eṣā dharmato dvija ।evam uktaḥ tu bhagavān vasiṣṭho muni sattamaḥ ॥1-53-10॥

translations.english: Addressed the by Viswamitra venerable and righteous Vasishta who was of the earth ascetic replied:
